title: Phonics and Reading
description: Letter sounds, tracing, and simple word practice.

levels.title: Letter A
levels.lessonText: A is for apple. Listen and say the sound.
levels.prompt: Which picture starts with the sound /a/?

levels.title: Letter B
levels.lessonText: B is for ball. Press the letter you hear.
levels.prompt: Choose the picture that begins with B.

levels.title: Letters C & D
levels.lessonText: C is for cat and D is for dog. Hear their sounds.
levels.prompt: Which picture starts with the sound /k/?

levels.title: Letters E & F
levels.lessonText: E is for egg and F is for fish. Listen closely.
levels.prompt: Find the picture that starts with E.

levels.title: Letters G & H
levels.lessonText: G is for goat and H is for hat. Hear the start sound.
levels.prompt: Which word starts with the /h/ sound?

levels.title: Letters I & J
levels.lessonText: I is for igloo and J is for jar. Practice the sounds.
levels.prompt: Which picture starts with the sound /i/?

levels.title: Letters K & L
levels.lessonText: K is for kite and L is for lion. Say them aloud.
levels.prompt: Choose the picture that begins with L.

levels.title: Letters M & N
levels.lessonText: M is for moon and N is for nest. Feel your lips move.
levels.prompt: Which picture starts with the sound /m/?

levels.title: Letters O & P
levels.lessonText: O is for owl and P is for pen. Notice the round sounds.
levels.prompt: Which picture starts with the sound /p/?

levels.title: Letters Q & R
levels.lessonText: Q is for queen and R is for rainbow. Listen carefully.
levels.prompt: Find the picture that starts with R.

levels.title: Letters S & T
levels.lessonText: S is for sun and T is for tree. Hiss like a snake /s/.
levels.prompt: Which picture starts with the sound /s/?

levels.title: Letters U & V
levels.lessonText: U is for umbrella and V is for van. Say the short /u/.
levels.prompt: Which picture starts with U?

levels.title: Letters W, X, Y, Z
levels.lessonText: W is for wind, X in fox, Y for yarn, Z for zebra.
levels.prompt: Which word ends with the sound /ks/?

levels.title: Blending: CAT
levels.lessonText: Put sounds together: /k/ - /a/ - /t/ makes CAT.
levels.prompt: Blend the sounds /k/ /a/ /t/. What word is it?

levels.title: Blending: DOG
levels.lessonText: Put sounds together: /d/ - /o/ - /g/ makes DOG.
levels.prompt: Blend the sounds /d/ /o/ /g/. What word is it?

levels.title: Blending: SUN
levels.lessonText: Put sounds together: /s/ - /u/ - /n/ makes SUN.
levels.prompt: Blend the sounds /s/ /u/ /n/. What word is it?

levels.title: Blending: PIG
levels.lessonText: Put sounds together: /p/ - /i/ - /g/ makes PIG.
levels.prompt: Blend the sounds /p/ /i/ /g/. What word is it?

levels.title: Sight Words: I and A
levels.lessonText: Some words we read on sight: 'I' and 'a'. I see a star.
levels.prompt: Tap the word 'I' in the choices.

levels.title: Sight Words: THE and IS
levels.lessonText: Common sight words: 'the' and 'is'. The sun is bright.
levels.prompt: Which word is 'the'?

levels.title: Phonics Celebration
levels.lessonText: Great job! Let's review sounds, blends, and sight words.
levels.prompt: Which word matches the sound of a shining /s/ /u/ /n/?
